statement: In an SSSL sliding-window pattern the S layers attend over a span half the sequence length, but the interleaved L layers already carry global context, so much of the S layers' distant attention is redundant with information the residual stream already holds.

scope.model: decoder-only transformer, 8 layers, d_model 512, 4 heads of 128
scope.budget: 300 charged training seconds on one H200

metrics.name: val_bpb
metrics.result: Architectural reading of _compute_window_sizes: short_window = sequence_len // 2 and every fourth layer plus the final layer are full-context. A prior OPHIS lineage measured halving the short span as its strongest confirmed lever, though at a different operating point with an auxiliary n-gram memory, so transfer to this baseline is open rather than established.
